note: apex-buy-stress-1121 (docs/67 §44): stress the 2026-11-21 Buy-mode crash on Apex Radiance 4.0.13 + RTX Remix bridge (AV in the bridge client SetStreamSource, d3d9.dll+0x3A91D / wild call from +0x27898, game wrapper 0x60F020; 2 of 3 tries of bp-speedlock-modeswitch-hf031b) until it breaks, with the culprit logged by [CrashForensics] VbGuard=1 (0.36.297-vbg1121b).
